notes.title: GodsTV Kickstarter is LIVE!!🔥
notes.content:
GodsTV is now LIVE on Kickstarter! 


We’ve just flipped the red switch—GodsTV is live on Kickstarter!! If you love 90’s-style arcade mayhem, jump in and taste our fame-show roguelike where every kill boosts your ratings and every betrayal is televised.

Kickstarter page: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/melbitspod/godstv-fame-is-fate?ref=ecrgqi

Early-bird backers will bag exclusive vanity gear, beta access and a first crack at the game’s most coveted God’s Gifts. 


[previewyoutube="0FEkK5jtUrU;full"][/previewyoutube]



Like, share, retweet, sell your soul, your furniture, your relatives... Do what you MUST!
Don’t forget to join our Discord and be part of the chaos all month long!



See you in the arena! — 

The Melbot Team

notes.title: GodsTV trailer out now, Kickstarter live July 8
notes.content:
It’s Fame Time! 
We aired today a brand-new trailer for GodsTV, the hottest Fame Show Arena Roguelike on galactic TV. 

This cartoony kill-fest for consenting adults is a madcap, irreverent parody of fame and violence. GodsTV turns every weapon, power-up and skill into product placement for the Sponsor-Gods.

“Because you’re no longer just a fighter, you’re a star.” 


[previewyoutube="_DN8DiGfoFk;full"][/previewyoutube]

Hit “Notify me” on Kickstarter
The clip also fires the starting pistol for the game’s Demo launch and Kickstarter campaign, coming out on July 8th 2025.  Early-bird backers will bag exclusive vanity gear, beta access and a first crack at the game’s most coveted God’s Gifts.
